info.title: tx — browse, edit, lint, diff, and deploy tabular semantic models
info.description: tx - open-source CLI for inspecting, validating, querying, testing, and deploying tabular semantic models (Power BI, Microsoft Fabric, Analysis Services).

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: browse, edit, lint, diff, and deploy tabular semantic models

commands.name: add
commands.description: Create a new object in the model

options.name: --model
options.description: Path to the semantic model: a TMDL folder, a .bim file, or a model folder

options.name: --output-format
options.description: Format for data written to stdout: text, json, csv, tmsl (alias: bim), or tmdl (default: text). Availability varies by command.

options.name: --error-format
options.description: Format for messages written to stderr: text or json (default: text). Unrecognized values fall back to text.

options.name: --server
options.description: Workspace to connect to: a name, a powerbi:// or asazure:// endpoint, or a local address

options.name: --database
options.description: Name of the semantic model to use on the workspace

options.name: --auth
options.description: How to authenticate: auto, interactive, spn, or managed-identity (default: auto)

options.name: --recent
options.description: Pick a model from the recently used list: no value opens a picker, a number picks that entry (1 is the most recent)

options.name: --debug
options.description: Show the full stack trace on stderr when an unexpected error occurs

options.name: --non-interactive
options.description: Never prompt for input. When required input is missing, fail with an error saying what to provide.

options.name: --yes
options.description: Skip confirmation prompts for destructive operations

options.name: --quiet
options.description:
Suppress non-essential output (spinners, progress, hints). Errors and data still print.
Run 'tx help <command>' for a command's options and examples.
Docs: https://bgarcevic.github.io/tomix-cli/
